items.headline: Council agenda: $11.8M for Finch Avenue property purchase
items.summary: The November 2 City Council consent calendar listed a budget modification adding $11,825,000 to the Parkland Dedication Fund to purchase the Finch Property at 10480 Finch Avenue. The money comes from the parkland fund.

items.headline: Council agenda: $850,000 Caltrans grant for McClellan Road Bridge design
items.summary: The November 2 consent calendar listed a resolution to accept $850,000 in Caltrans-administered Community Project Funding. It would also award Biggs Cardosa Associates a design services agreement of up to $1,278,700 for the McClellan Road Bridge Project.

items.headline: City Hall advisory committee agenda covers building's condition and future options
items.summary: The City Hall Community Advisory Committee's October 29 agenda listed a discussion and request for input on City Hall's existing conditions, facility needs, and future options. The public could comment in person, over Zoom, or by email to CityHallCAC@santaclaraca.gov.

items.headline: Sunnyvale commission agenda: below market rate in-lieu fee changes
items.summary: The October 28 Housing and Human Services Commission agenda listed a recommendation to the City Council to convert the below market rate in-lieu fee for ownership developments to a square footage-based fee and amend the in-lieu fees for rental and ownership developments. It also listed an amendment to Council Policy 2.3.3 to require periodic reviews of the city's inclusionary housing policy.

items.headline: Planning commission agenda: more bonuses for preserving historic buildings
items.summary: The October 28 Planning & Transportation Commission agenda listed a public hearing on a recommendation for a zoning text amendment at 51 Encina Avenue. It would expand floor area bonus and transfer-of-development-rights benefits for Category 1 and 2 buildings on the city's Historic Inventory, and would change the municipal code sections on transfer of development rights and CS development standards.

items.headline: Commission agenda: 60% design plans for Quarry Road Transit Connection
items.summary: The October 28 Planning & Transportation Commission agenda listed a staff presentation and review of the 60% plans for the Quarry Road Transit Connection. The agenda lists the project as statutorily exempt from CEQA.

items.headline: Mountain View council agenda listed City Attorney appointment in closed session
items.summary: The October 27 closed session agenda listed a public employee appointment for the City Attorney position. It also listed a labor negotiator conference about the City Attorney, who is an unrepresented employee.

items.headline: LinkedIn development agreement amendment up for second reading in Mountain View
items.summary: The October 27 City Council agenda listed the second reading of an amendment to LinkedIn's development agreement covering 700-810 East Middlefield Road and 1100-1200 Maude Avenue. A second reading is typically the final step in adopting an ordinance.
